Disable or restore Quick Settings tiles, launcher shortcuts, and widgets exposed by installed apps. This changes the Android component enabled state and requires Root only when you perform a change.

Counts apply only to currently visible components. App-level selection changes only modifiable components; protected or unknown-state items are skipped. The All view does not hide apps because of selection state.
Checked means the component is disabled. State is always read directly from the current system; modification history is not stored or inferred.

Checking disables immediately and unchecking explicitly enables immediately, without an extra confirmation dialog. Disabling can affect features currently using the component; enabling does not restore the original default state.
Only standard tile services, shortcut creation activities, and widget receivers are managed. This never disables the entire app.
Only standard TileService components are listed. Built-in system tiles without an independent service, such as Wi-Fi or Bluetooth, are unsupported; core system components are display-only.
Standard shortcut creation activities only. Dynamic shortcuts and private ShortX items are not included. Disabling may affect other entry points using the same Activity.
Receivers with widget declarations. Disabling can break placed widgets; enabling does not guarantee restoration of the previous layout.
